fields.Trigger: Cash transaction in single business day

workflows.name: Cash Transaction Monitoring & Covered Transaction (PHP 500K Single-Day) Detection

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitors aggregate single-day cash transactions per customer" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-validate of "validates customer identity and transaction legitimacy" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "files Covered Transaction Report" (replaces manual Step 3).
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Failure to file CTR incurs PHP 500K penalty per transaction; mitigated by automated monitoring
System Touchpoints: - Cash-transaction monitoring engine; CTR generator; AMLC portal

steps.activity: ERP monitors aggregate single-day cash transactions per customer; flags covered transactions exceeding PHP 500K (single or series) per AMLA
Compliance validates customer identity and transaction legitimacy; determines covered-transaction reportability
Compliance files Covered Transaction Report (CTR) with AMLC within 5 working days; archives filing

fields.Trigger: Monitoring rule alert or analyst referral

workflows.name: Suspicious Transaction Detection, Alert Triage & Escalation

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "generates suspicious-activity alerts based on rules" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews customer KYC, transaction pattern, business rationale" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-document of "documents decision rationale" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-488 (ensure controlled execution — AML Transaction Monitoring & STR/CTR Reporting (AMLC) (PA-86.2).)
- operational: tuned rules and analyst training
Pain Points / Risks: - **Detection risk**: Missed suspicious activity; mitigated by tuned rules and analyst training
System Touchpoints: - Alert/exception engine; case triage workflow; documentation repository

steps.activity: ERP generates suspicious-activity alerts based on rules (unusual size, velocity, structure, customer profile mismatch)
Compliance triages alerts: reviews customer KYC, transaction pattern, business rationale; dismisses false positives
Compliance escalates true positives for STR filing and possible relationship exit; documents decision rationale

workflows.name: Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) Filing with AMLC

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-generate of "prepares STR with required details" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews and approves STR" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "records per AMLA retention" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: MLRO process and confidentiality controls
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance/legal risk**: Failure to file STR or tipping-off incurs penalty and criminal liability; mitigated by MLRO process and confidentiality controls
System Touchpoints: - AMLC STR portal; case file; tipping-off prevention controls

steps.activity: Compliance prepares STR with required details: subject identity, transaction details, grounds for suspicion, supporting evidence
MLRO reviews and approves STR; files via AMLC portal within 5 days of determination; maintains confidentiality (no tipping-off)
Compliance/Legal supports any AMLC follow-up investigation; preserves records per AMLA retention; manages customer relationship outcome

workflows.name: Covered Transaction Report (CTR) Filing & AMLC Portal Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-count of "Compliance compiles CTR data" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews and files CTR via AMLC portal within prescribed period" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-record of "Compliance archives CTR records" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - operational: batch process and timeliness tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Compliance risk**: Late/inaccurate CTR; mitigated by batch process and timeliness tracking
System Touchpoints: - CTR generator; AMLC portal; filing archive

steps.activity: Compliance compiles CTR data: subject identity, transaction type, amount, date, account/reference
MLRO reviews and files CTR via AMLC portal within prescribed period; maintains filing acknowledgment
Compliance archives CTR records; tracks filing timeliness for audit

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-detect of "detects structuring patterns" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-review of "reviews intent, business rationale" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-file of "files STR if structuring confirmed" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-488 (ensure controlled execution — AML Transaction Monitoring & STR/CTR Reporting (AMLC) (PA-86.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Detection risk**: Sophisticated structuring evades single-transaction threshold; mitigated by pattern analytics
System Touchpoints: - Pattern-detection engine; case workflow; LP coordination

steps.activity: ERP detects structuring patterns: multiple sub-threshold cash transactions by same customer/related parties within short period
Compliance investigates: identifies related customers/accounts, reviews intent, business rationale
Compliance files STR if structuring confirmed; restricts/blocks customer; coordinates with LP for any in-store angle

fields.Trigger: Import/export transaction or vendor red flag

workflows.name: Trade-Based Money Laundering (TBML) Monitoring for Import/Export

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "monitors import/export for TBML indicators" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-file of "files STR if TBML suspected" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-488 (ensure controlled execution — AML Transaction Monitoring & STR/CTR Reporting (AMLC) (PA-86.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Detection risk**: Complex TBML schemes hard to detect; mitigated by red-flag indicators and cross-reference
System Touchpoints: - TBML indicators dashboard; invoice/shipping reconciliation; AMLC/BOC portal

steps.activity: Compliance monitors import/export for TBML indicators: invoice over/under-valuation, phantom shipments, third-party payment, rapid movement of goods
Compliance cross-references invoice value vs. market price, shipping docs vs. actual goods, payment source vs. customer
Compliance files STR if TBML suspected; coordinates with BOC and AMLC; exits vendor relationship if warranted

Legal cooperates with PNP/NBI investigation per lawful order; provides evidence under court supervision

workflows.name: AML Rule Tuning, Threshold Governance & False-Positive Reduction

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-analyze of "analyzes rule performance" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-log of "IT tunes thresholds and scenario logic" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "reviews rule-tuning governance annually" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-488 (ensure controlled execution — AML Transaction Monitoring & STR/CTR Reporting (AMLC) (PA-86.2).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Effectiveness risk**: Over-tuning suppresses real alerts; mitigated by shadow validation and audit
System Touchpoints: - Rule-performance analytics; tuning workflow; audit evidence

steps.activity: Compliance analyzes rule performance: alert volume, false-positive rate, true-positive yield, coverage gaps
IT tunes thresholds and scenario logic; validates in shadow mode before production; documents change
Internal Audit reviews rule-tuning governance annually; validates detection effectiveness
